details.description: Elevate your daily cleansing routine with Cinthol Original Foam Body Wash, a refreshing and invigorating experience that leaves your skin feeling clean, protected, and energised. Transform your daily routine with Cinthol Original Foam Body Wash, the ultimate solution for clean, healthy, and protected skin.

details.description: Cinthol Deostick is a deodorant like you have never tried before. Made from cream formulation, not spray, it lasts 3 times longer than ordinary deo's and is gentle on your skin too. Use it after shower to experience that awesome feeling all day long.
details.usageInstructions:
Step 1 - After a shower, take the Cinthol Deo Stick and gently squeeze out a small amount. 
Step 2 - Directly apply onto your skin, moving the tube in a circular motion. There is no need to use hands for application.
